exposure: Group A: LMWH prophylaxis for 7 days
Low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) prophylaxis after elective caesarean delivery (CD)
outcome: Treatment suspension due to decreased platelet count
cohort: 529 pregnant women aged >35 years who underwent elective CD after a physiological single pregnancy
finding: No thromboembolic events were observed in either group, but maternal haemorrhage requiring transfusion and surgical site complications were more frequent in the LMWH prophylaxis group.
mod_finding: The study investigated the need for low-molecular-weight heparin prophylaxis after elective cesarean delivery in women over 35 years old and found no difference in thromboembolic events between those who received prophylaxis and those who did not.
